description: Teacher Profile tab screen, MVI, replacing the stub for HomeTab.MY_TEACHER_CHAT. It has the profile header (photo/initials, Mr./Mrs. name, subject, bio), a Chat with teacher card that navigates to HomeRoute.TeacherChat, a Courses & subscriptions section (shared JanaCourseCard; tap → CourseDetail; Subscribe → CourseDetail(openCheckout = true), the existing flow), and a Live lessons & subscription section (JanaSubscriptionStatusCard with a live-subscription checkout through the existing JanaBottomSheet + CourseCheckoutSheetContent, activated only after verification, plus upcoming lessons using the existing UpcomingLessonCard/NextLessonItem; tap → LessonDetail, Join → openZoomUrl). Each section has its own loading/error-retry/empty state. Also writes the impl notes. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Full spec: plan item 3 in d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/.agents/tasks/teacher_plan.md.
steps: Read plan item 3 of d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/.agents/tasks/teacher_plan.md and the FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings.

Create feature/home/.../tabs/teacher/presentation/profile/TeacherProfileContract.kt with TeacherProfileUiState(isProfileLoading = true, profile, profileError: String?, isCoursesLoading = true, courses: List<Course>, coursesError, isLessonsLoading = true, lessons: List<LiveLesson>, lessonsError, isSubscriptionLoading = true, subscription: TeacherSubscription?, subscriptionError, checkout: CheckoutUiState = CheckoutUiState()) : MviState. CheckoutUiState is imported from tabs/courses/presentation/detail. Intents: Load, RetryProfile, RetryCourses, RetryLessons, RetrySubscription, OpenChat, OpenCourse(courseId), SubscribeCourse(courseId), OpenLesson(lessonId), JoinZoom(url), SubscribeLiveLessons, PaymentMethodSelected(method), PayClicked, RetryPayment, DismissCheckout. Effects: NavigateToChat, NavigateToCourseDetail(courseId, openCheckout = false), NavigateToLessonDetail(lessonId), OpenZoomUrl(url), ShowNoZoomLink, LiveSubscriptionActivated.

Create TeacherProfileViewModel(getActiveTeacherProfile, getCourses: GetCoursesUseCase, observeCourses: ObserveCoursesUseCase, getTeacherUpcomingLessons, getLiveLessonsSubscription, createLiveSubscriptionCheckout, verifyLiveSubscriptionPayment). init: Load starts 4 independent section loaders, and the ViewModel collects observeCourses() and applies it only when !isCoursesLoading (as in CoursesViewModel). Each Retry* reloads one section. SubscribeCourse → NavigateToCourseDetail(id, openCheckout = true). JoinZoom with a blank url → ShowNoZoomLink, else OpenZoomUrl. Copy the checkout state machine from CourseDetailViewModel: SubscribeLiveLessons opens SELECTING_METHOD only if subscription?.isPurchasable == true && status IDLE; Pay → PROCESSING → createLiveSubscriptionCheckout(subscription.planId, method) → VERIFYING → verify; keep pendingSessionId until a final answer and re-verify on Retry after PENDING; on SUCCESS && isSubscribed re-fetch the subscription and apply only if status == ACTIVE, then set CheckoutUiState(status = SUCCESS) + LiveSubscriptionActivated, else FAILED; DismissCheckout is ignored while busy; never set ACTIVE locally. Add a TODO about backend-driven gating of lessons by live subscription.

Create TeacherProfileScreen.kt. TeacherProfileScreen(viewModel: TeacherProfileViewModel = koinViewModel(), navigator: AppNavigator = koinInject()) collects effects: NavigateToChat → navigator.navigate(HomeRoute.TeacherChat); NavigateToCourseDetail → HomeRoute.CourseDetail(id, openCheckout); NavigateToLessonDetail → HomeRoute.LessonDetail(id); OpenZoomUrl → openZoomUrl(url); ShowNoZoomLink → snackbar live_no_zoom_link; LiveSubscriptionActivated → snackbar payment_subscription_activated. It then calls the stateless TeacherProfileContent(state, snackbarHostState, onIntent), whose Scaffold has contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0) and a snackbarHost. Inside, a LazyColumn with contentPadding 16.dp and spacedBy 16.dp holds, in order: the profile header (JanaLoadingState / JanaErrorState(error_generic, btn_retry, RetryProfile) / JanaProfileHeader(teacherDisplayName(name, gender), subject, bio, photoUrl, teacher_profile_photo_cd)); JanaNavigationCard(teacher_profile_chat_title, teacher_profile_chat_subtitle, Icons.AutoMirrored.Rounded.Chat) → OpenChat; JanaSectionHeader(teacher_profile_courses_section) followed by loading / error(RetryCourses) / JanaEmptyState(courses_no_courses) / items(courses, key = id) JanaCourseCard(course.toCardUiModel(), OpenCourse, SubscribeCourse); JanaSectionHeader(teacher_profile_live_section) followed by the subscription loading / error(RetrySubscription) / JanaSubscriptionStatusCard mapped by a private composable helper per plan item 3c (status labels subscription_status_*; detailText active_until/expired_on with formatShortDate, or subscription_live_unlock_desc; priceText price?.formatted() when not ACTIVE; actionLabel subscribe/renew/none; onAction only when isPurchasable; isActionLoading = checkout.isBusy), and then the lessons loading / error(RetryLessons) / JanaEmptyState(live_no_upcoming) / items keyed by id, where LIVE_NOW uses UpcomingLessonCard(lesson, OpenLesson, JoinZoom(lesson.zoomUrl)) and everything else uses NextLessonItem(lesson, OpenLesson). After the Scaffold, when checkout.isVisible && subscription != null, show JanaBottomSheet(onDismissRequest = DismissCheckout, dismissEnabled = !checkout.isBusy) { CourseCheckoutSheetContent(itemTitle = subscription.planName, priceText = subscription.price?.formatted(), checkout, ...intents) }.
Register viewModel { TeacherProfileViewModel(get(), get(), get(), get(), get(), get(), get()) } in tabs/teacher/di/TeacherModule.kt.
